art_direction.identity: A taproom wall painted deep cobalt: foam-white type, hairline rules, and beer itself as the only other color. No cards, no gradients, no neon. The tap list is the design.
art_direction.type: Anybody run wide (font-stretch 130–150%, weights 700–900) for headings, tap numbers and prices; Onest for everything else. No third family.
art_direction.color: One accent: amber (bg-primary) — the Come by tonight button, tags like New or Last keg, and nothing else. Beer colors (pale, straw, gold, haze, amber, copper, ruby, brown, stout) are data: each tap's color field paints its glass. Never use them as decoration.
art_direction.signature: The tasting flight and the tap board. The hero's paddle holds the taps marked 'In the hero flight' as CSS-drawn glasses in their true colors, and the tap board lists every featured tap with its number, glass, style, ABV and pour price. Both live in the Taps collection; keep them wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Dry, specific, confident. Numbers over adjectives, short sentences, one joke at most. No exclamation points, no hop puns.
